import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on ["Date", "Date"]
# Join Source2_35_0 and Source2_35_1 on the "Date" column
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, how="inner", left_on="Date", right_on="Date", suffixes=('_0', '_1'))

# Operation 2: group_by = [Source2_35_0.Date], aggregations = [avg(Source2_35_0.ResultDir), sum(Source2_35_1.NumMosquitos)]
# Group by Date (from Source2_35_0, which is the same as Date in joined table)
# Aggregate ResultDir by average and NumMosquitos by sum

# Ensure ResultDir is numeric (float), coercing errors if any
df_joined['ResultDir'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['ResultDir'], errors='coerce')
df_joined['NumMosquitos'] = pd.to_numeric(df_joined['NumMosquitos'], errors='coerce')

agg_df = df_joined.groupby('Date').agg({
    'ResultDir': 'mean',
    'NumMosquitos': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

# Cast columns to target schema types explicitly
agg_df['Date'] = agg_df['Date'].astype(str)
agg_df['ResultDir'] = agg_df['ResultDir'].astype(float)
agg_df['NumMosquitos'] = agg_df['NumMosquitos'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Convert 'Date' columns to string to ensure consistent join keys
source0['Date'] = source0['Date'].astype(str)
source1['Date'] = source1['Date'].astype(str)

# Convert ResultDir to numeric, coercing errors to NaN (some values might be non-numeric)
source0['ResultDir'] = pd.to_numeric(source0['ResultDir'], errors='coerce')

# Join on Date (inner join to keep only matching dates)
joined = pd.merge(source0[['Date', 'ResultDir']], source1[['Date', 'NumMosquitos']], on='Date', how='inner')

# Convert NumMosquitos to numeric (it should be numeric but just in case)
joined['NumMosquitos'] = pd.to_numeric(joined['NumMosquitos'], errors='coerce')

# Group by Date and aggregate: average ResultDir and average NumMosquitos
result = joined.groupby('Date', as_index=False).agg({'ResultDir': 'mean', 'NumMosquitos': 'mean'})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
result = result[['Date', 'ResultDir', 'NumMosquitos']]

# Write to output CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_35/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
